::: info MODULE-FOR-AWAIT
**A script that awaits is a module**

Any &lt;script&gt; that uses top-level await must be type="module".

**Why.** In a classic script top-level await is a syntax error, and the application opens blank.

<small>Applies to every shape · checked by the lint (`await-in-classic-script`) · [MODULE-FOR-AWAIT in Constraints](/docs/constraints#MODULE-FOR-AWAIT)</small>
:::
